listNote: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them. Names, descriptions and grades from the official list; hidden status from the Planet GTA 6 visible/hidden split, cross-checked against the kit's count of 28 hidden.

psn.name: Official PSN trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
psn.covers: Official names, descriptions and grades for all 55 trophies

p6.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list
p6.covers: Visible vs hidden split (27 visible, 28 hidden), grades, story length

ss.name: Sixshore GTA 6 trophy guide
ss.covers: Roadmap order, the Chapter 1 missable, counts, platinum time

stages.name: Chapter 1 — first steps
stages.note: Open the story, and meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot before the chapter ends — it is the one confirmed missable.

stages.name: The story — Chapters 2 to 4
stages.note: Play the main missions in order. Chapter and mission trophies unlock as the story reaches them.

stages.name: Strangers & side strands
stages.note: Finish the side characters' strands and the stranger missions between story beats.

stages.name: Activities, challenges & crime
stages.note: The open-world bulk: races, ranges, challenges, robberies and odd jobs.

stages.name: Collectibles & the map
stages.note: Sweep Leonida region by region for cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles and garages.

stages.name: 100% & the platinum
stages.note: The completion checklist opens after the story; the platinum pops with the last trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The long pole is A Long Road (100% completion), so finish the story first, then work the stages in order; guide writers put the platinum at about 200 hours.

steps.text: Work the guide's six stages in order, finishing the story (stages 1–2) before the open-world grind — the roadmap order comes from SixShore.
Clear the Chapter 1 balcony meditation spot before Chapter 1 ends; it is the one missable step on the road to the platinum, and OutputLag stresses manual saves because there is no mission replay.
Treat A Long Road (100% completion) as the long pole and save it for last; the checklist only opens after the story.
Budget roughly 200 hours — PowerPyx's estimate — or up to 250 hours on SixShore's longer estimate.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.gate: Story window — the opening mission; it unlocks as the story starts.
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks as the story starts, so it is the first trophy most players earn.

steps.text: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
The mission unlocks as the story starts, so just follow the opening beats in order — this is the first trophy most players earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.gate: Story window — earned by finishing Chapter 1; check the missable below first.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot for Positive Mental Attitude — that spot goes away with the chapter.

steps.text: Before you finish Chapter 1, meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot — the spot disappears when the chapter ends.
Make a manual save at the chapter's end so you have a fallback — OutputLag stresses manual saves at every chapter because there is no mission replay.
Finish the final mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.gate: Story window — earned by finishing Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progress only — keep playing the main missions in order.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 main missions in order; side content can wait until the chapter trophy pops.
Make a manual save when the chapter ends, as OutputLag advises at every chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.gate: Story window — earned by finishing Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story progress only — the chapter trophy pops when the last mission of the chapter ends.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 main missions in order until the last mission of the chapter ends.
Make a manual save when the chapter ends, as OutputLag advises at every chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.gate: Story window — earned by finishing Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story progress only — the last chapter before the final mission.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main missions in order — this is the last chapter before the final mission.
Make a manual save when the chapter ends, as OutputLag advises at every chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.gate: Story window — the final mission; the story runs about 60 hours.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. The story runs about 60 hours, so this gold is the last story trophy most players earn — and the moment the 100% checklist opens.

steps.text: Finish Chapters 1–4 in order; the final mission only unlocks after Chapter 4.
Make a manual save before starting the final mission — there is no mission replay, so a pre-finale save is your only way back.
Complete the final mission; the gold pops when it ends.
After the credits, the 100% completion checklist opens — that is when the endgame grind for A Long Road begins.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.gate: Story window — tied to its mission; complete it when the story offers it.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run when the story offers it. Story missions unlock in order, so you cannot skip ahead to it.

steps.text: Play the story in mission order until Breakfast Run is offered — story missions cannot be skipped ahead to.
Complete Breakfast Run; the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.gate: Story window — tied to its mission; complete it when the story offers it.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist, so it arrives in the mission order — play the story and it comes.

steps.text: Play the story in mission order until The Cartel Heist is offered — it is a story heist, so it arrives in the mission order.
Complete The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.gate: Story window — tied to its mission; complete it when the story offers it.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play when the story offers it.

steps.text: Play the story in mission order until Child's Play is offered — story missions cannot be skipped ahead to.
Complete Child's Play; the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.gate: Story window — tied to its mission; complete it when the story offers it.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners when the story offers it.

steps.text: Play the story in mission order until Headliners is offered — story missions cannot be skipped ahead to.
Complete Headliners; the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.gate: Story window — tied to its mission; complete it when the story offers it.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown when the story offers it. The airport is the setting — expect it mid-story, in mission order.

steps.text: Play the story in mission order until VCIA Takedown is offered — expect it mid-story, at the airport.
Complete VCIA Takedown; the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.gate: Story window — tied to its mission; complete it when the story offers it.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory when the story offers it.

steps.text: Play the story in mission order until Operation Savage Glory is offered — story missions cannot be skipped ahead to.
Complete Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the checklist opens after the story and covers the missions, strands, activities and collectibles across Leonida. It is the last trophy before the platinum for most players.

steps.text: Finish the story first — the 100% checklist only opens after the final mission.
Work the checklist category by category: missions, stranger strands, activities and collectibles.
Clear the stranger strands (stage 3) and the activities (stage 4) before the collectible sweep, following the roadmap order.
Use the in-game checklist to find the last few percent — it tracks every category across Leonida.
Expect this to be the last trophy before the platinum; it pops the moment the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts count across free roam — jumps, near misses and airtime all add up, so this finishes on its own if you drive hard between missions.

steps.text: Drive hard in free roam — jumps, near misses and airtime all count toward the 250.
Chain stunts between missions rather than grinding them in one sitting; the count builds across the whole playthrough.
The target is 250 of 397 possible stunts — every guide that states a count agrees on it, so track your progress against 250.
Use fast cars and long straights for airtime, and traffic-heavy roads for near misses.
Keep driving aggressively into the endgame — the trophy usually lands on its own if you never drive carefully.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — all 9 activity types. Dip into one of each early so you know what the map offers, and this pops fast.

steps.text: Try one of each of the 9 activity types — a single taste of each is enough.
Dip into a new activity type whenever you pass one on the map instead of hunting them all at once.
Use the map's activity markers to find types you have not tried yet.
The trophy pops the moment the ninth type is tried — no need to win or finish any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the ranges weapon by weapon; gold needs clean runs, so replay a challenge until the medal flips.

steps.text: Visit all 12 shooting ranges — the 42 gold challenges are spread across them (GTABase counts 42 golds across 12 ranges).
Work through the challenges weapon by weapon, one range at a time.
Replay any challenge until the medal flips to gold — clean runs are what gold needs.
Learn each challenge's target pattern on a first run, then go for the gold score on the replay.
Check the per-range tally as you go so no range is left half-finished.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — all 14 of them. Learn each course's line before racing it for the win.

steps.text: Find all 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida.
Fly each course once to learn its line before racing for the win.
Win a race at every location — one win per location counts, replays at the same spot do not add more.
Save the hardest courses for last, once you know the drone handling.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race counts once, so spread your wins across the map instead of replaying one favourite.

steps.text: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so spread wins across the map.
Do not replay a favourite race for progress; a second win there adds nothing.
Pick a fast, well-handling car for each race type before the start line.
Work through the race markers region by region so none are missed.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so land the bigger catch before time runs out.

steps.text: Find Cal's fishing challenge and accept it — fishing challenges are head-to-head.
Land the bigger catch before the timer runs out.
A loss is not final — challenge Cal again until you take one win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through to the end.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet and pick the shortest game on offer.
Play it through to the end — the trophy pops when the game is completed, not just started.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.gate: Side-strand window — finish Andy's strand before the endgame.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — the last job in his strand. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for Andy's marker between story beats.

steps.text: Watch the map for Andy's strand marker between story beats — stranger strands unlock as you explore.
Play Andy's missions in the order they appear; each one unlocks the next.
Complete Andy's final mission — finish the strand before the endgame, as the guide advises.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.gate: Side-strand window — finish Kenton's strand before the endgame.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — the last job in his strand.

steps.text: Watch the map for Kenton's strand marker between story beats — stranger strands unlock as you explore.
Play Kenton's missions in the order they appear; each one unlocks the next.
Complete Kenton's final mission — finish the strand before the endgame, as the guide advises.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.gate: Side-strand window — finish Billy's strand before the endgame.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — the last job in his strand.

steps.text: Watch the map for Billy's strand marker between story beats — stranger strands unlock as you explore.
Play Billy's missions in the order they appear; each one unlocks the next.
Complete Billy's final mission — finish the strand before the endgame, as the guide advises.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strands are the side stories marked on the map — finish any 8 of them, and the character strands in this stage count toward it.

steps.text: Complete any 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida.
The named character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — all count toward the 8.
Pick up new strands whenever their markers appear on the map; do not leave them all for the endgame.
The trophy pops when the eighth strand's final mission is done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.gate: Side-strand window — finish Randy's strand before the endgame.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — the last job in his strand.

steps.text: Watch the map for Randy's strand marker between story beats — stranger strands unlock as you explore.
Play Randy's missions in the order they appear; each one unlocks the next.
Complete Randy's final mission — finish the strand before the endgame, as the guide advises.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.gate: Side-strand window — finish Tyrone's strand before the endgame.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — the last job in his strand.

steps.text: Watch the map for Tyrone's strand marker between story beats — stranger strands unlock as you explore.
Play Tyrone's missions in the order they appear; each one unlocks the next.
Complete Tyrone's final mission — finish the strand before the endgame, as the guide advises.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — all 18 spots. MISSABLE: the Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears after Chapter 1 and there is no mission replay, so meditate there before you finish the chapter; the other 17 spots stay open.

steps.text: Meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot BEFORE finishing Chapter 1 — the spot disappears with the chapter and there is no mission replay.
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — GTABase and GTA Zone both count 18 spots (GTA Zone: in 10 locations).
Work the spots region by region so none are missed; the other 17 stay open after Chapter 1.
Make a manual save after the Chapter 1 spot, as OutputLag advises at every chapter.
Honest caveat: six sources call this the only possibly missable trophy, but PlanetGTA6 says it cannot tell yet — treat the Chapter 1 spot as missable to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a one-off target — track it, take the shot, and bring it back.

steps.text: Find Bret and take on his hunt — the target is a one-off unique animal, not a regular hunt.
Track the animal to its location and take the shot when you have a clear line.
Bring the hunt back to Bret to close the job — the trophy pops when the hunt is handed in.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a finished set counts, so track down the missing cards set by set.

steps.text: Hunt collectible cards across Leonida — cards are scattered, so check every region.
Track your progress set by set, and chase the missing cards in a set before moving on.
A finished set is what counts — three completed sets pop the trophy, not a raw card total.
Work region by region so no area is left half-swept.
Use the map and your collection tally to find the last few cards in each set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app marks spots as you use it — work through the map region by region so none are missed.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app and use it at marked spots — the app logs each location as you go.
Work through the map region by region so no area is left half-done.
Hit 100 distinct locations — repeats at the same spot do not add to the count.
Check the app's tally as you go to see how many locations remain.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the open-world checklists — combat, driving and exploration feats that tick off as you play.

steps.text: Complete 50 challenges — combat, driving and exploration feats that tick off as you play.
The target is 50 of 80 challenges — every guide that states a count agrees on it, so track your progress against 50.
Tick off challenges naturally as you play — many complete on their own during the story and side content.
Check the challenge list regularly to see which feats are close to done.
Save the long grinds for the endgame, once the quick feats are banked.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears.

steps.text: Bring your partner along, then build a 4 star wanted level — the trophy needs the partner beside you.
Break line of sight once the heat is on: duck into alleys, switch vehicles, and stay out of sight until the search passes.
Stay hidden until the wanted level clears — the trophy pops when the heat is fully off.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in one run and keep the heat on between them — do not let the wanted level drop.

steps.text: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together — the run has to be back-to-back.
Rob the first shop to raise your wanted level, then move straight to the next one.
Keep the heat on between shops — do not let the wanted level drop, or the chain breaks.
Hit the third shop while the wanted level is still live; the trophy pops when the third robbery lands.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts, so take a spin in anything unfamiliar you see parked or passing.

steps.text: Drive anything unfamiliar you see — every new vehicle you drive counts toward the 100.
Take a spin in parked and passing vehicles alike; a short drive is enough to log the discovery.
Check the vehicle tally as you go, and hunt the rare types in the regions you have not swept yet.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — a crowded firefight is the moment.

steps.text: Wait for a crowded firefight with at least five enemies in reach before you trigger Combat Focus.
Trigger Combat Focus and drop five enemies before it ends — line the shots up fast.
If the count falls short, the run is not wasted — set up the next crowded fight and try again.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The airport is the scene — leave it in a way the schedule never planned, by air rather than by the front door.

steps.text: Head to VCIA airport — the airport is the scene for this one.
Find a plane on the airfield rather than heading for the front door.
Take off in it — leave the airport by air, in a way the schedule never planned.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — Rhinos are tanks, and the joke description points at taking one on. Deal with a Rhino on your own terms and the trophy pops.

steps.text: Find a Rhino tank — Rhinos are tanks, and the trophy's joke description points at taking one on.
Deal with the Rhino on your own terms — take it on directly and come out on top.
The trophy pops once the encounter is resolved in your favour.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store and go in quiet — stay out of sight lines from the door onward.
Take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted.
Leave before anyone raises the alarm — the trophy pops on a clean getaway.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vault jobs are the big robberies — plan the getaway before you crack the vault, five times over.

steps.text: Plan each vault job before you start — the getaway matters as much as the crack.
Crack the vault, take the cash, and get out clean — five vaults in total.
Lose the heat after each job before starting the next one.
Work the vaults one at a time across the map; each escape counts toward the five.
The trophy pops when the fifth vault escape is complete.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit the truck, grab the cash, and lose the heat before it catches up.

steps.text: Find an armored truck on the road and hit it — the truck is the target, not a building.
Grab the cash from the truck once it is stopped.
Lose the heat before it catches up — the trophy pops on the escape, not the hit.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. The map fills in as you travel, so drive every road and visit every corner of the state.

steps.text: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the map fills in as you travel.
Drive every road and visit every corner of the state, region by region.
Watch the map for blank patches — an unexplored corner is easy to miss at the edges.
The trophy pops when the last area fills in on the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — all 9 gangs. One operation per gang counts, so spread the jobs across the map.

steps.text: Rob one Illegal Operation per gang — all 9 gangs count, one job each.
Spread the jobs across the map; a second hit on the same gang adds nothing.
Track which gangs you have hit so the last one does not get missed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront, order the drink, and take in the view.
trophies.confirm_note: Name, grade and description confirmed by 7 sources; unlock method disputed - PowerPyx gives a specific bar-and-drink method, while four other guides say the exact steps are not confirmed yet.

steps.text: Head to the beachfront on Ocean Beach and find a spot with a view.
Order a cocktail there and enjoy it with the view — that is the trigger as PowerPyx describes it.

Honest caveat: the exact steps are disputed — PowerPyx gives a specific bar-and-drink method, while four other guides say the method is not confirmed yet, so do not be surprised if the first try does not pop it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The showroom is the set piece — drive out through it, not around it.
trophies.confirm_note: Name, grade and description confirmed by 7 sources; unlock method disputed - PowerPyx gives a specific showroom-car method, while four other guides say the exact steps are not confirmed yet.

steps.text: Find a vehicle showroom and get into one of its cars.
Drive out through the showroom itself — smash your way out, not around it, in classic style.
Honest caveat: the exact steps are disputed — PowerPyx gives a specific showroom-car method, while four other guides say the method is not confirmed yet.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at the alley and see it through to the end.

steps.text: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game — follow-through means seeing it to the end, not just rolling a frame.
The trophy pops when the game is complete.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is a joke line and guide writers have not pinned the exact trigger down yet — it reads as a partner moment, so play the duo content and watch for it.

steps.text: Play the duo content with your partner — the description reads as a partner moment, and no guide has pinned the exact trigger down yet.
Keep playing partner content and watch for it; the trophy lands when the moment triggers.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks a count to 500 — decisions across the game add up, so keep choosing and this lands late in a long playthrough.

steps.text: Keep making decisions across the game — PlayStation tracks a count to 500.
Choices add up across the whole playthrough, so this lands late in a long game.
Do not grind it early — play normally and check the tracked count in the endgame.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is not yet pinned down by guide writers — the name points to succeeding on a second attempt at something that first went wrong.
trophies.confirm_note: Name, grade and description confirmed by 7 sources; no source confirms the unlock trigger - PowerPyx calls it currently unknown and only guesses a link to a payday-loans store.

steps.text: No source confirms the trigger yet — the name points to succeeding on a second attempt at something that first went wrong, so retry anything you fail.
PowerPyx calls it currently unknown and only guesses a link to a payday-loans store — treat that as a guess, not a method, until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A secret or easter-egg moment — guide writers have not confirmed the exact trigger yet, so explore the strange corners of Leonida.
trophies.confirm_note: Name, grade and description confirmed by 7 sources; unlock method disputed - PowerPyx gives a specific UFO-easter-egg method, while four other guides say the exact steps are not confirmed yet.

steps.text: Explore the strange corners of Leonida — this is a secret or easter-egg moment.
The only published lead is PowerPyx's UFO-easter-egg method — check the PowerPyx guide for its steps.
Honest caveat: the method is disputed — four other guides say the exact steps are not confirmed yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock someone down with it.
trophies.confirm_note: Name, grade and description confirmed by 7 sources; no source confirms the unlock trigger - PowerPyx calls it currently unknown and only guesses a kick from a motorcycle.

steps.text: Try a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock someone down with it.
No source confirms the trigger yet — PowerPyx calls it currently unknown and only guesses a kick from a motorcycle, so treat that as a guess, not a method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from jobs — run them through your contacts until the total hits $250,000.

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from jobs — they are the raw material for this one.
Run the bills through your contacts to launder them, and keep the total climbing.
The trophy pops when the laundered total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts toward the total, so spend steadily instead of saving it all.

steps.text: Spend steadily across all shops — every shop purchase counts toward the $100,000.
Do not hoard your cash; buy gear, clothes and supplies as you go.
The trophy pops when total spending hits $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8 of them. Buy every garage on the market; they also give you somewhere to keep the 100 vehicles.
trophies.confirm_note: Name, grade and description confirmed by 7 sources; garage count disputed - the trophy text says 8 purchasable garages, PowerPyx's database lists 12 locations.

steps.text: Buy every garage property on the market — the trophy text says 8 purchasable garages.
Garages also give you somewhere to keep the 100 vehicles for Whip It Good, so buy them as you collect.
Honest caveat: the count is disputed — PowerPyx's database lists 12 garage locations against the trophy text's 8 purchasable garages, so track purchases against the trophy text's 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle, and repeat until 10 are on the books.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app and register a vehicle.
Repeat with different vehicles until 10 are on the books.
The trophy pops when the tenth vehicle is registered.
